# Generated default keymap reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-keymap-reference.scm; do not edit. -->

The repository default prefix is `C-t`. Personal Guix Home configuration may deliberately replace it (for example with `Print`); this page describes the dependency-light repository default loaded from `scheme/init.scm` and `scheme/default-config.scm`.

## Direct bindings

| Sequence | Description |
|---|---|
| `XF86AudioLowerVolume` | decrease volume 5% |
| `XF86AudioMute` | toggle audio mute |
| `XF86AudioRaiseVolume` | increase volume 5% |
| `XF86MonBrightnessDown` | decrease brightness 5% |
| `XF86MonBrightnessUp` | increase brightness 5% |
| `s-q` | emergency compositor quit |
